AcmeCorp - Sarah: Hey team — after last night's reranker rollout (looks like it went live around 02:15 UTC) our retrieval+rerank results for our knowledge base searches are degraded. Previously the top-3 always contained the correct doc; now it's often missing. Citations are wrong and hallucinations increased. Repro steps below, example queries and responses attached.

Asha (CS): Thanks Sarah. Can you confirm: hosted API or Dedicated? org id? Any rapid repro we can point Eng to? :eyes:

AcmeCorp - Sarah: Hosted API, org_id=11223. Endpoint: POST /v1/retrieval -> then /v1/rerank. Sample query: "How do I rotate API keys?". Previously the top doc had title "Rotating API keys" with citation. Now top doc is an unrelated faq. I'm attaching 10 failing queries to the Zendesk ticket.

ZendeskBot: Created ticket #CS-34567 for org 11223 (priority: high).

Luis (Eng): Looping in eng-runtime. We did a reranker model swap in the rollout tag 20260314-rerank-swap. That swapped from rerank-v2.0 -> rerank-v2.1 and adjusted score normalization. Mina, did that rollout include any embedding model/ index pipeline changes?

Mina (PM): The release included two changes: (1) rerank scoring normalization to reduce length bias, (2) minor change to the retrieval pipeline that flips the default vector similarity metric from cosine to inner_product for new indices (we thought they'd be equivalent but maybe not).

QA (Arun): I ran a local regression on our KB eval set. Numbers: recall@3 dropped from 0.87 -> 0.62, MRR dropped 0.78 -> 0.51 after the rollout. I reindexed one shard with the old similarity (cosine) and recall went back up. Attached a small diff of scores.

Asha (CS): This looks like a significant regression impacting customers. Sarah — is this blocking production for you? Would you accept a temporary rollback/canary?

AcmeCorp - Sarah: Yes, blocking. Customer-facing search in production has degraded. A canary rollback for just our org is acceptable.

Luis (Eng): Triage plan: 1) Confirm which model_variant and similarity metric the org is hitting (logs), 2) Check rerank score distribution + normalization changes, 3) Reproduce offline with the exact index used by AcmeCorp, 4) If we confirm the similarity change caused it, pin org to old index/similarity or rollback reranker normalization.

Luis (Eng): Can you paste an exact request/response you used? even better: cURL + response snippet.

AcmeCorp - Sarah: Here's a minimal repro (redacted tokens):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/retrieval \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "org_id": "11223",
    "query": "How do I rotate API keys?",
    "top_k": 10,
    "index": "kb-production-v4"
  }' | jq '.'
```

Sample (post-rerank) response snippet: 

```json
{
  "results": [
    {"doc_id": "faq-934", "score": 0.41, "title": "Rate limits FAQ"},
    {"doc_id": "kb-210", "score": 0.36, "title": "Billing questions"},
    {"doc_id": "kb-999", "score": 0.30, "title": "Rotating tokens (community)"}
  ]
}
```

Previously top result used to be `kb-120` "Rotating API keys" with score ~0.84.

Luis (Eng): Thanks. First check: ingestion metadata — did we accidentally apply a metadata filter at query time? That would drop docs. Also need to inspect the vector similarity used to build the index. Mina, can you point to the rollout PR?

Mina (PM): PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/merge_requests/1789 — the description mentions changing default similarity for new indexes to inner_product to match hardware perf optimizations.

Luis (Eng): Hypothesis: inner_product + new normalization + reranker length-penalty changed score ordering and degraded recall for short, exact-match KB entries. Quick reproducer path: re-run retrieval with both similarity params and reranker-v2.0 vs v2.1. Arun — can you add the small eval harness to run both configs?

QA (Arun): On it. Running 10k queries now across 3 index configs. Early glance: inner_product + rerank-v2.1 is worst. cosine + rerank-v2.0 best.

eng-platform (Jules): We can create an org-scoped routing override to pin org 11223 to the older stack while Eng investigates. We'll need service approval and a config change to routing rules (policy: org_id == "11223" -> reranker: rerank-v2.0, index_metric: cosine). I can push the change as a soft canary for 24h.

Luis (Eng): Please do that, Jules. Also add a trace-level log for the next 6h to capture model_variant + similarity per request for org 11223.

Asha (CS): I've communicated to Sarah that we're initiating a canary pin and will follow up in ticket CS-34567. Sarah, ETA for us pushing the canary?

eng-platform (Jules): Can do within 90 minutes. Need infra signoff for the logging increase.

AcmeCorp - Sarah: Thank you — that helps with immediate mitigation. We'll stand by to validate.

Luis (Eng): Action items assigned: Luis -> run offline A/B eval + check normalization code path; Arun -> finish regression run and attach failing queries; Jules -> create org pin canary + elevated logs; Asha -> update customer ticket & confirm validation steps; Mina -> open hotfix PR to revert similarity change or make it opt-in for existing indices.

Mina (PM): Opening hotfix MR now and marking it urgent.

Asha (CS): Keeping this thread updated. If anyone finds a quick config flag we can flip instead of full revert, call it out.

AcmeCorp - Sarah: We'll validate once the canary is live and report back within 30 minutes.

Luis (Eng): FYI for records: likely root causes in combination: similarity metric change + new reranker normalization. Both small individually but together they alter rank ordering. Plan: revert path = org pin OR revert normalization change in rerank-v2.1. Longer term: add canary tests for retrieval+rerank combos and add a pre-rollout eval on held-out KBs for customers with documented SLAs.

ZendeskBot: Updated ticket CS-34567: status -> investigating; note -> org pin requested.

(End of thread for now — follow-ups to be recorded in CS-34567 and MR 1792.)
